sloka: यस्येषुपदमासाद्य विनाशम् यान्ति शत्रवः ।कथम् न प्R^थिवी तस्य शासने स्थातुमर्हति ॥२-४४-१३॥
transliteration: yasyeṣupadamāsādya vināśam yānti śatravaḥ ।katham na pR^thivī tasya śāsane sthātumarhati ॥2-44-13॥

translations.english: When enemies who are targets of his arrows are destoyed, how can this earth, not stay under the command of Rama?
